title: Redman's Optimizations
description: Better optimizations for Minecraft without any extras
body:
🚀 Optimized for All-In-One Performance

This modpack is a hand-picked collection of the best performance mods available, designed to provide an all-in-one FPS boost for every player. Whether you are playing on a high-end rig or a budget laptop, this pack ensures your game runs as smoothly as possible.
## Key Features

- Ultimate FPS Boost: Includes essential mods like Sodium, Lithium, and Starlight to maximize your frame rates.

-  All-in-One Convenience: No need to hunt for individual mods; everything you need for a lag-free experience is right here.

-  Smart Optimizations: Pre-configured settings to reduce stuttering and memory usage.

    ![2GB of ram test](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe29a72e1de07dde173f770f6b60633e11bf352a.png)

## Troubleshooting Tips

If your FPS is lower than expected, try the following:

   Remove Dynamic FPS: Some systems may conflict with this mod.

   Disable Vsync: This can often help unlock higher frame rates and reduce input lag.

## Community & Support

We are always looking to improve! If you have any ideas for new mods or plugins that should be added to the pack, please let us know.

   Email: professorredman.dev@gmail.com

   Project Goal: To provide the most accessible performance experience for the community.
